Amposta — Madrid, Spain

🟡 Local press research

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Calle Amposta is one of the most repeatedly and severely documented streets in this entire research: a stabbing witnessed by a resident on the street roughly 18 months before an April 2026 report, narcopisos that 'expanded' into the street from 2023 onward, residents forming night patrols 'en pie de guerra' out of fear, and press headlines describing the barrio's 'angustioso dia a dia' (anguished day-to-day life). Coverage is multi-year (2023-2026) and multi-source. Sources checked: Articulo14, 8 May 2026 (stabbing witness); La Razon, 8 May 2026; 20Minutos, 13 Oct 2023 (narcopisos expand to Amposta); Telemadrid, 10 Sept 2024; Noticias para Municipios, 27 May 2026 (resident mobilisation).
